services.name: School Field Trips
services.desc: Looking for a special place to bring your students or children’s group? Come to Imagine That!!! Voted one of the best children’s discovery environment in Morris County, our educational exhibits and convenient layout make us an ideal place to bring a field trip for children pre-school to second grade. Imagine That!!! is renovated! We feature new and updated exhibits to provide a place for children to learn through play! Come see our sensory friendly exhibits, play grocery store, arts & crafts area, and much more.Children are not required to go through the discovery environment in any specific order, but rather may explore at their own pace.
